Suddenly, your bodies seemed to grow lighter.{w}

With a strange whirring, a Tetramystica glides across the floor.{w}{p}A Tetramystica specialized for guard duty -- a "Guard Mystica," you might call it.{w}{p}Here and there the students have scrawled on it: "Idiot," "Moron," even doodled nose hairs.{w}Even so, its function of guarding the Academy is still fully intact.{w}{p}So it is only natural that, on spotting you outsiders who don't belong to the Academy, it moves to eliminate you.{w}

You have run into a foe you never expected.{w}A vast form, its whole body blazing with light.{w}{p}Without a sound, the very air shudders and trembles.{w}With the word "alien" lodged in your hearts, you stand exposed to its savage power.{w}
Suddenly, a gigantic beast appears before you.{w}Half tiger and half horse, it flails its arms and thrashes its whole body wildly.{w}{p}And now its fury turns on you as well.{w}

Darkness within darkness.{w}Welling up from the abode of the Nether King, it fills the air around it with an incomprehensible tongue.{w}{p}What it is saying: unknown.{w}What it is even trying to do: unknown.{w}{p}But one thing is clear:
it means to destroy you.{w}

A giant leaps out in front of you.{w}It seems to be distracted by something else.{w}{p}It doesn't appear able to tell whether you are enemies or mere visitors.{w}{p}No -- for just a moment it seemed to give it some thought, but
'Eh, I'll just punch them for now and...'{w}seems to be the conclusion it reached.{w}

"Alrighty! I'm gonna make a strawberry shortcake with Makana Essence in it~!
My baking arm's just itching to go!!"{w}

Mucha took the Makana Essence
and went pitter-pattering off into the kitchen.{w}
"Sorry to keep you waiting! So, what do you think of this cake!"{w}
{0E}    *    Mixed Good-and-Evil Parties Unlocked    *    {0F}{w}
"Huh? You're not giving it to me?{w}What's with that? I can't believe you!!{w}*stomp stomp STOMP*!!"{w}
"Welcome! You must be hungry, huh?{w}I'll get some hot food ready for you, so hang on a sec!"{w}

The Strange Bookmark vanished,
as if drawn up into the sky.{w}
"You got it!{w}Now then, follow your big sis~!"{w}
"Oh my, you're quite the reserved type, aren't you?{w}

{0E}"Oh my, you're quite the reserved type, aren't you?{0F}
...It makes me want to tease you.{w}Ahahaha!"{w}
"Well, well.{w}And that's the end of big sis's explanation.{w}Think there's anything I can help you with?"{w}

Natori had a word with the guards,
and you were given special permission to sit in on the council.{w}
The council doesn't seem to have started yet.{w}You can see Balgert standing there, feet planted wide like a temple guardian.{w}
"*griiin*"{w}
It's creepy how he keeps grinning to himself even though no one else is here.{w}

...It seems someone has come in.{w}{p}Heels clicking sharply,
the elven empress made her appearance.{w}

'That's Lady Rianna. The queen of the Roscadil Empire.{w}She's leading the development of the mana furnace
and the magic airship herself, from the front.'{w}

Clad in heavy armor,
Rianna surveys the room with a piercing gaze.{w}
"I thought I was late... but it is the same as always, I see."{w}
"*griiin*"{w}
"What a dreadful face. What happened?"{w}
"Heh heh heh... Rianna."{w}
"What."{w}
"Heh heh heh heh... Oh, Miss Riannaaa!"{w}
"If you have no business with me, do not address me so familiarly.{w}...Mere human."{w}

"We found the Lightstair Ruins, y'know!{w}The site of the Stairway of Light -- the one you lot bragged
'could never be found'!"{w}
"Oh?{w}And yet no one has confirmed that the Stairway of Light has appeared."{w}
"Nngh... W-well...{w}there's still all sorts of stuff we gotta find..."{w}
"Then stop making a fuss over every little thing.{w}We do not consider ourselves to be in competition with you."{w}

"On finding the Lightstair Ruins,
allow me to offer my congratulations."{w}{p}"...However,
even if you were to reach the Palace of the Sun before us,
you could never bring about true peace."{w}
'Lady Rianna is so harsh, isn't she...{w}But her dignified bearing has won her plenty of admirers.'{w}
"My friends! It is I, Barjeff!!{w}King Balgert, Empress Rianna, you both look well!"{w}
"Yeah, I'm bursting with health, all right!!"{w}
"So the tiresome one has come."{w}
'That's Lord Barjeff.{w}He rules Teridon, and he's fabulously rich.{w}He has a bit of a troublesome habit, though...'{w}

"Even far apart, I felt the love of each of you.{w}Unable to see Barjeff,
you must have been so lonely, so miserable!"{w}{p}"I understand, I understand...{w}

{0E}"I understand, I understand...{0F}
So let's have a hug!!"{w}
"Hey, wait, cut it out--{w}That's gross, don't you latch onto me!!"{w}
"I love you, I love you, Balgert!{w}Mmmnn, mmfuuuuuunnn!!"{w}
"I don't want--{w}that kinda... thiiing...........{w}Get offa me, dammiiiiiit!!"{w}
"Perhaps I should have arrived a little later..."{w}

"Dwahaaaah...!
That was a fine hug!!"{w}

"Now, now, Rianna, you're next!{w}Today of all days,
let us share a hug, shall weeeee!!"{w}
"...Lay so much as one finger on me.{w}I will blast you with the magic gun that sleeps in my arm."{w}
"Sorry, sorry, I'm late!{w}

{0E}"Sorry, sorry, I'm late!{0F}
...Oi, Barjeff. You're in the way. Whaddaya think you're doin'?"{w}
"Mmmmmnn..."{w}
'That's the chief of Ogre Bay, Lord Fulgrant.{w}He's always late to the Central Council.'{w}

'And last but not least, this gentleman.{w}The ruler of Lumisthenes --
our very own Council Chair Wattner~!'{w}

"Is that everyone?{w}Then shall we begin
the Central Council of the Crestard Continent?"{w}

"Let us get straight to it: the recapture of the Palace of the Sun.{w}I have received several proposals from you all,
and I would like to hear how things stand."{w}{p}"First, Lord Balgert, if you would."{w}

"Thanks to the adventurers,
we managed to find the site of the Stairway of Light.{w}But the Three Phantom Stones were gone."{w}
"It is an ancient structure, after all.{w}Finding it at all could be called a miracle."{w}

"I've told the adventurers
to keep searching for the Three Phantom Stones.{w}I'll have 'em go to Natori for advice -- that all right?"{w}
'They already have~ Just kidding.'{w}
"Of course, that is no problem.{w}Please, make good use of her."{w}

"I plan to get the army out searching soon, too.{w}Takes a snake to know a snake's path, sure,
but I can't leave it all to the adventurers."{w}
"That would be wise.{w}...Then, Lady Rianna, if you would."{w}

"The magic airship Meatrif
has entered the trial ignition stage of its mana furnace.{w}But we still lack the Celestial Readings, among other things."{w}
"Is it able to fly?"{w}
"Simple levitation is already possible.{w}But the navigation controls will take a little more time."{w}
"It does not matter.{w}Just keep us accurately informed of the situation at the Palace of the Sun."{w}
"Lady Rianna, and Lord Balgert.{w}For now, we have no choice but to rely on the two of you.{w}Please, I entrust the Palace of the Sun to you."{w}
"Hey, Wattner, we did a little thinkin' of our own."{w}
"Thank you, Lord Fulgrant.{w}Would you share it with us?"{w}
"So, about the Palace of the Sun...{w}

{0E}"So, about the Palace of the Sun...{0F}
Why don't we just shoot it down?"{w}
"Huh?"{w}
"We'll build a great big cannon!{w}Let's go out with a bang -- 'KA-BOOOOOM!'!!"{w}
"Can-nonnn..."{w}

"Shoot it down, beat the Kin of Darkness to a pulp,
then just stick it back up in the sky. Easy, right?"{w}
"Hahaha...{w}
{0E}"Hahaha... {0F}No."{w}

"Why the hell not!?{w}Their plans get the go-ahead,
but ours gets shot down!?"{w}

"For starters,
you can't build a cannon that reaches all the way to the Palace of the Sun, can ya?"{w}
"No, no!{w}Fulgrant, I sense no love in that plan!!"{w}

"So let's hug!
Together with Barjeff, let us search for love once more!"{w}
"You keep your trap shut!"{w}

"...They could probably build that cannon."{w}{p}"The technology of ogres and goblins
holds much ancient wisdom the rest of us have lost.{w}It is not to be taken lightly."{w}

"Heh, that's Rianna for ya.
You get it."{w}
"But I am not in favor of shooting it down.{w}There is no telling whether it could be returned to the sky."{w}
"Hmph. Chickenin' out, are ya."{w}

"Lumisthenes will continue, as before,
to support the plans of
Lord Balgert and Lady Rianna."{w}{p}"If any of you others have a good idea,
I would be grateful if you would let us know."{w}

"If you need logistics or funding,
come talk to Barjeff and Teridon, won't you?{w}
"Then, we are adjourned.{w}The Palace of the Sun shines equally upon the land and upon all of you.{w}Please do not forget that..."{w}

The kings nodded at Wattner's words
and left the room.{w}
